errors.quote: For chunk values $H,D$, the updates $D\gets D-H$, $H\gets H+D$, $D\gets H-D$ send $(H,D)$ to $(H,D-H)$, then $(D,D-H)$, then $(D,H)$.
errors.problem: The page does not say the outer updates are componentwise over (Z/q^bZ)^m. The circuit's middle shear is componentwise, so all three updates must use that same group. Read as whole chunk values mod q^e, the outer updates would not compose with the middle shear into a swap. The paper says 'componentwise'.
